## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New screen / component
- [ ] `fix`: UI bug / state fix
- [ ] `perf`: Table virtualization / render optimization
- [ ] `refactor`: Clean up component architecture
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Build or package upgrades

## Quality & Compliance Checklist
- [ ] Tested in major browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)
- [ ] No hardcoded URLs or exposed API tokens
- [ ] All commits cryptographically signed
- [ ] User feedback (toasts, loading skeletons, error states) implemented
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly without warnings

- [ ] Department receive status toggles verified
- [ ] Result entry range checks and doctor approval verified
- [ ] Report print / PDF layout verified
